manifest:
# Benchmark harness for cluster-DAG builders. Not published and not part of the
# crate package: it is its own workspace and is excluded by the package
# include list in the crate manifest.
[package]
name = "vg-bench"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
description = "Benchmark harness comparing cluster-DAG builders"

[workspace]

[features]
# Builds the reference meshlet builder pinned in `BEVY_REV`. Large dependency
# tree; the rest of the harness does not need it.
bevy = ["dep:bevy_pbr", "dep:bevy_mesh", "dep:bevy_asset", "dep:bevy_tasks"]

[dependencies]
meshoptimizer-rs = { path = "<worktree>", features = ["clusterlod", "parallel"] }
rayon = "=1.11.0"
gltf = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["utils"] }
zstd = "0.13"
lz4_flex = { version = "0.14", features = ["frame"] }
bevy_pbr = { git = "https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy", rev = "8cc060f01c3d4d5920781124cc8c32013bb47730", default-features = false, features = ["meshlet_processor"], optional = true }
bevy_mesh = { git = "https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy", rev = "8cc060f01c3d4d5920781124cc8c32013bb47730", optional = true }
bevy_asset = { git = "https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy", rev = "8cc060f01c3d4d5920781124cc8c32013bb47730", optional = true }
bevy_tasks = { git = "https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy", rev = "8cc060f01c3d4d5920781124cc8c32013bb47730", optional = true }

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
debug = false
